nodes.label: Schuim — stadsbrouwerij template
nodes.rationale: Maatwerk-tier horeca template (dark x amber, Archivo). Archetype K: tabbed/segmented content hub — the tap list is the beating heart, presented as an accessible tabset (Vast op vat / Wisselend / Binnenkort) with ABV badges and status pills; segmented-control nav, tour booking form, live open-status supporting past-midnight closing.

nodes.label: WAI-ARIA tab-hub tap list (roving tabindex, automatic activation)
nodes.rationale: Full WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard pattern: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected + hidden syncing, roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down with wrap-around plus Home/End, automatic activation on focus move. Panels animate taps in with staggered fadeUp only when motion is allowed.
